title: Conformance export host for PDF/A, PDF/X and PDF/E
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-cli --test cli export_conformance and cargo test -p pdfxi-cli --bin pdfxi conformance pass; pdfxi export conformance plans, exports and verifies all six supported profiles; EXPORT-008 moves to verified.
notes: Hosts the existing conformance plan/normalizer: profile resolution (canonical and compact labels), --plan, --policy report|reject, --output-intent validation, individual --no-* switches, and post-export verification of page text, header version and required catalog entries.
